_comment: Generated by tools/cad/gen/block_capacity.js - do not hand edit. Allowable load of one block before it cracks, per type.
method: analytic (ACI 318 bearing, AISC 360 E3); NativeCAD cad_fea_run was unavailable (capability_missing: fea)

fea.reason: cad_fea_case returned capability_missing: no CalculiX solver installed on the NativeCAD host
fea.recipe: cad_fea_case {fixed: bottom face, pressure 10 MPa: top face}, material per type; capacity = yield / (sigma at that pressure) x pressure x netArea

bedNote: sand / mortar bedding under a landing block (assumed); impact force F = v * sqrt(k_eff * m) with k_eff = 1/(1/k_axial + 1/k_bed), divided by the type ductility factor

CONCRETE.basis: phi 0.65 x 0.85 f'c 30 MPa on the 3.0 m^2 cored section (ACI 318-19 22.8)

BRICK.basis: same cored geometry as tower_block (tinted), clay density 1800 kg/m^3, f'm 20 MPa, phi 0.65 x 0.85

STEEL.material: ASTM A992 W14x90 column on 50 mm plates
STEEL.basis: phi 0.9 x Fcr x Ag, AISC 360-16 E3, KL/r = 12.7, Fe 12.3 GPa; the cap plates spread an overhung load (area exponent 0.5); ductility 6 lets the column absorb impact energy plastically (impactDuctilityFactor = sqrt(2*6-1))
